description: This file provides service functions for managing sharing of notes, including creating share entries and listing shares for a specific note in the note organizer backend.

classes.name: ShareListItem
classes.description: Data class representing a share item in the list, including share id, note id, shared email, permission, and creation timestamp.

methods.name: User|None _get_user_by_email(session: AsyncSession, email: str)
methods.description: Helper function to retrieve a User object by email asynchronously.

methods.name: NoteShare create_share_flow( session: AsyncSession, *, note_id: uuid.UUID, owner_user_id: uuid.UUID | None, email: str, permission: str, )
methods.description: Public asynchronous function to create a sharing record for a note with a user identified by email, handling conflicts and not found errors.

methods.name: list[ShareListItem] list_shares_flow( session: AsyncSession, *, note_id: uuid.UUID, owner_user_id: uuid.UUID | None )
methods.description: Public asynchronous function to list active shares for a specific note, with optional ownership verification.
